changelog:
- Initial release of the dataset-datasheet skill.
- Provides a structured datasheet template to document datasets, including motivation, composition, collection process, preprocessing, uses/limits, distribution, and maintenance.
- Includes clear guidance on required inputs and quality checks for dataset documentation.
- Highlights common anti-patterns to avoid when documenting datasets.
- Based on "Datasheets for Datasets" (Gebru et al., 2018) and responsible AI data documentation best practices.
